equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; sex (pregnant women) and age (live-born infants) only define the population. Location of birth (states vs territories) is geography.

notes: The 'higher' (trimester) and 'similar' (symptom status) claims rest on group percentages with separate CIs; no contrast, test or overlap rule is stated, so no test is recorded. Significantly higher prevalence ratios are cited from the Zika Birth Defects Surveillance System, not computed here. Pregnancy-loss defects come from unpublished data.
